text:
Zara: dropped a tiny mock of the approval modal for prompt-set diffs. goal: clarify copy, keyboard flow, and SR announcements before we hand to eng.
Ethan: first pass: modal title should read 'Approve regression fixes' not just 'Approve' so context shows up in browser history.
Priya: keyboard: focus must land on primary action when modal opens, Esc cancels, Tab cycles within modal. add hint 'Press Enter to confirm' next to primary button.
Lena: screen reader: announce 'Approval modal: 3 diffs selected. Press Esc to cancel.' use aria-modal and role=dialog. after confirm, announce '3 diffs approved' via aria-live.
Sam: copy nit: confirm button should say 'Approve 3 diffs' (explicit). secondary action 'Review unresolved comments' instead of vague 'View'. include undo in toast: 'Approved — Undo'.
Ethan: visual: show severity badge and reason line for each diff in the modal. keep modal scannable by limiting to 6 lines, add 'Show more' for long lists.
Priya: a11y color: severity chips need icon+text; don't rely on color alone. ensure contrast for chips against modal surface >=3:1.
Zara: flow question: if someone else resolves a diff while modal open, do we warn? propose inline update: disable that item and append 'Already resolved by <name>'.
Sam: mobile: modal becomes full-screen; primary action anchored to bottom, large touch target. keyboard shortcuts vary so show small helper in header.
EvalBot: automated note: eval run 2333 attached. summary: 6 diffs, 2 regressions. backend PR #790 will support modal counts and resolved flags.
Zara: thanks all — I'll update the figma with new title, explicit CTAs, aria snippets, and the concurrent-resolve state. will post PR and tag for quick a11y pass. :sparkles:
